literal_source_claim: The Cesaro means for a continuous function converge.
canonical_claim: For a continuous function on the circle, the first-order Cesaro means of its symmetric Fourier partial sums converge uniformly to the function.
domain_and_universes: Expected domain AddCircle T with T > 0 and codomain complex numbers (or a checked real-valued specialization); exact period and scalar convention remain open.
quantifiers: continuous function f on AddCircle T
natural Cesaro index n tending to infinity
hypotheses: f is continuous, preferably represented as a bundled continuous map
conclusion: The selected Cesaro means of the selected symmetric Fourier partial sums converge uniformly to f.
excluded_degenerate_cases: A nonpositive period is excluded. The zero/initial mean convention, constant functions, real-valued specialization, and pointwise consequence must be fixed or transported explicitly at statement freeze.
